text:
maria: Quick heads up — Stratify (partner) agreed to a joint launch: marketplace listing + benchmark blog + 60-min webinar the week of May 12. Need to lock timeline, assets, lead routing, and an initial comms draft. :rocket:

aj: Nice. We should treat this as a single GTM slice: 1) marketplace listing -> drives signups, 2) benchmark blog -> SEO + credibility, 3) webinar -> demo + MQLs. Routing: HubSpot form -> partner > marketing queue -> SDR sync.

sam: For the webinar demo, we should do a short live integration walkthrough (5–7m) + cost/latency benchmark highlights. I can provide a tiny demo repo and a pre-recorded 3m clip as fallback.

nina: Partner side confirms two speakers: their PM + their infra lead. They want the blog to highlight the marketplace listing metrics and an end-user case study. They asked for a co-authorship by May 2.

leo: Draft landing page outline: hero + 2 CTAs (Marketplace listing / Webinar sign-up) + benchmark snapshot + FAQ. We need UTM strategy and event codes to map to attribution.

priya: Assets checklist from marketing: hero image, 1x social card, 2x quote graphics, short teaser video (15s), blog draft, speaker bios, and a slide deck template. Who owns which?

maria: Priya — marketing owns social cards + landing page. Sam — demo materials + demo repo. Nina — partner assets and approvals. Leo — tracking/UTMs + landing page build. Aj — flow for inbound routing + SDR handoff. Camila — webinar production (panel + Q&A moderation).

camila: I can run the webinar ops. Suggest: 25m content (demo + benchmark), 15m live Q&A, 5m CTAs. Need speaker runbook and rehearsals with partner two days before. Can we book rehearsal windows May 8 & May 10? :calendar:

aj: Routing notes: please use this HubSpot form id: FORM-8743. Map to lifecycle_stage=lead, source=partner_marketplace. SDR playbook: contact within 24h, email template "Stratify launch follow-up". I'll add a Zapier mapping if partners need MQL push.

maria: Example UTM for links: https://redwood.example/stratify?utm_source=partner_stratify&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=stratify_launch

leo: Pasting UTM snippet for devs to copy:
```
utm_source=partner_stratify
utm_medium=marketplace
utm_campaign=stratify_launch
utm_content=webinar_signup
```

pri ya: small correction on participants list in the Google Calendar invite — please use full names and titles for partner speakers. We had confusion last time.

sam: For the benchmark blog, propose sections: 1) test setup & hardware, 2) workloads (latency P50/P95, throughput), 3) cost per 1k tokens, 4) integration notes + best practices, 5) appendix with raw numbers. I'll prepare the raw CSV by Apr 28.

nina: Partner legal needs a copy of the blog + webinar script for review 72h before publish. They also asked for a short joint quote.

maria: Timeline draft: Apr 20 — finalize landing + UTMs; Apr 28 — raw benchmark CSV; May 2 — blog draft & partner review; May 6 — social cards + promo ready; May 8/10 — rehearsals; May 12 — webinar + listing live; May 13 — nurture email + blog publish. Thoughts?

camila: Timeline looks good. Can we add a pre-webinar teaser email for the partner's list two days before?

aj: Yes — teaser on May 10 evening (partner send), main invite May 4 (multi-channel). Also add paid LinkedIn boost for the blog for 48h after publish. Budget TBD.

leo: Tracking checklist: UTMs on all partner links, unique marketplace offer code (STRATIFY25) tied to GA goal, Webinar unique event tracking, HubSpot hidden fields. I'll push the tracking spec to the landing PR.

maria: We need copy snippets for partner to include in their marketplace listing. Short (1 liner + 2 bullets). I'll draft and share by EOD.

priya: I'll start designing social cards; need hero image high-res and partner logo SVGs. Nina can you get logos and brand colors?

nina: Sending logos and brand guide now. Also confirming the partner legal contact: legal@stratify.com.

deploy-bot: [scheduler] Draft blog created at https://cms.redwood.example/drafts/stratify-benchmark-1767777777 — status: draft. :white_check_mark:

maria: Great — next steps owners recap: marketing (Priya, Leo) — landing + assets; product (Sam) — demo + benchmark CSV; partners (Nina) — approvals + logos; growth (Aj) — routing + paid; events (Camila) — webinar ops. I'll make a shared project board and link here. :link: 

camila: Also want to test a 20-min lightning track for advanced users if partner ok (short technical deep-dive). Vote :+1: to add?

sam: +1 for lightning deep-dive. We can pre-record to save live time.

nina: Partner is open to a short technical micro-session. Confirmed.

maria: OK locking that. I’ll put rehearsal times in calendar and create the HubSpot form. Everyone — if you need anything from partner/legal/infra, ping me directly. Thanks! :raised_hands:
